title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: Bilbo Baggins, a comfort-loving hobbit, is swept into a quest with thirteen dwarves and the wizard Gandalf to reclaim a treasure guarded by the dragon Smaug.

title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
description: Kvothe, a legendary magician and musician, tells the story of his orphaned youth, his years at a university of magic and his search for the demons who killed his family.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
author: J.K. Rowling
description: An orphan boy learns on his eleventh birthday that he is a wizard and begins his first year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.

title: A Game of Thrones
author: George R.R. Martin
description: Noble houses scheme and wage war for the Iron Throne of Westeros while an ancient threat gathers beyond the great northern Wall.

title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
author: Brandon Sanderson
description: In a world of ash and mist ruled by an immortal emperor, a street thief discovers she can burn metals for magic and joins a crew planning a heist.

title: The Fellowship of the Ring
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: Frodo inherits a dark ring of power and sets out with a fellowship of hobbits, men, an elf, a dwarf and a wizard to destroy it.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: On the desert planet Arrakis, young Paul Atreides is caught in a war over the spice melange, the most valuable substance in the galaxy.

title: Foundation
author: Isaac Asimov
description: A mathematician predicts the fall of the Galactic Empire and sets up a foundation of scientists to shorten the dark age that will follow.

title: Ender's Game
author: Orson Scott Card
description: A gifted child is trained at a space battle school through ever harder war games to lead humanity against an alien invasion.

title: The Martian
author: Andy Weir
description: An astronaut stranded alone on Mars must use his wits, botany and engineering to survive until rescue can reach him.

title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship with no memory and must save Earth from a dimming sun, helped by an unlikely alien friend.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson investigate a legendary spectral hound said to haunt the Baskerville family on the misty moors of Devon.

title: Murder on the Orient Express
author: Agatha Christie
description: Detective Hercule Poirot must solve a murder aboard a snowbound luxury train where every passenger seems to have a secret.

title: Gone Girl
author: Gillian Flynn
description: When a wife disappears on her fifth wedding anniversary, suspicion falls on her husband as a twisting psychological thriller unfolds.

title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
author: Stieg Larsson
description: A journalist and a brilliant hacker investigate a decades-old disappearance inside a wealthy and secretive Swedish family.

title: The Silent Patient
author: Alex Michaelides
description: A famous painter shoots her husband and never speaks again, and a psychotherapist becomes obsessed with uncovering her motive.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet spars with the proud Mr. Darcy in a witty story of love, manners, marriage and first impressions in Regency England.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Bronte
description: An orphaned governess falls in love with her brooding employer Mr. Rochester, whose house hides a dark secret.

title: The Notebook
author: Nicholas Sparks
description: An old man reads a love story from a faded notebook to a woman in a nursing home, recalling a summer romance that lasted a lifetime.

title: Me Before You
author: Jojo Moyes
description: A cheerful young carer takes a job looking after a wealthy man paralysed in an accident, and both of their lives change.

title: Outlander
author: Diana Gabaldon
description: A nurse from 1945 is transported back in time to eighteenth-century Scotland, where she is caught between two men and two eras.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: Through young Scout's eyes, her father Atticus defends a Black man falsely accused of a crime in a small Alabama town.

author: George Orwell
description: Winston Smith lives under the watchful eye of Big Brother in a totalitarian state that controls truth, history and even thought.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: The mysterious millionaire Jay Gatsby throws lavish parties on Long Island in pursuit of his lost love Daisy Buchanan.

title: Crime and Punishment
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
description: A poor former student in St. Petersburg commits a murder and is tormented by guilt, fear and a patient detective.

title: Animal Farm
author: George Orwell
description: Farm animals overthrow their human farmer, only to see the pigs who lead them become tyrants in this allegory of revolution.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical guide to building good habits and breaking bad ones through tiny changes that compound into remarkable results.

title: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People
author: Stephen R. Covey
description: Seven principles of personal and professional effectiveness, from being proactive to sharpening the saw.

title: Deep Work
author: Cal Newport
description: Argues that focused, distraction-free work is rare and valuable, with rules for training concentration and productivity.

title: How to Win Friends and Influence People
author: Dale Carnegie
description: Timeless advice on communication, listening, handling people and making others feel important.

title: Mindset
author: Carol S. Dweck
description: A psychologist explains the difference between a fixed and a growth mindset and how beliefs about ability shape success.

title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
description: A handbook of agile software craftsmanship on writing readable, maintainable programming code with good names, small functions and tests.

title: The Pragmatic Programmer
author: Andrew Hunt and David Thomas
description: Practical advice for software developers on craftsmanship, automation, debugging, testing and career growth.

title: Introduction to Algorithms
author: Thomas H. Cormen
description: A comprehensive textbook on algorithms and data structures, from sorting and graphs to dynamic programming.

title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
author: Martin Kleppmann
description: Explains the ideas behind reliable, scalable and maintainable data systems: databases, replication, partitioning and streams.

title: The Mythical Man-Month
author: Frederick P. Brooks Jr.
description: Classic essays on software engineering and project management, including why adding people to a late project makes it later.

title: Steve Jobs
author: Walter Isaacson
description: The life of the Apple co-founder, based on interviews with Jobs, his family, friends and rivals.

title: Wings of Fire
author: A.P.J. Abdul Kalam
description: The autobiography of India's missile man and former President, from a boyhood in Rameswaram to leading the space and missile programmes.

title: The Diary of a Young Girl
author: Anne Frank
description: The diary of a Jewish teenager hiding with her family from the Nazis in a secret annex in Amsterdam.

title: Long Walk to Freedom
author: Nelson Mandela
description: Mandela's autobiography of his childhood, his struggle against apartheid, 27 years in prison and his election as president.

title: Elon Musk
author: Walter Isaacson
description: A biography of the entrepreneur behind Tesla and SpaceX, his drive, risks and controversies.

title: Sapiens
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: A brief history of humankind, from the cognitive revolution of early humans to agriculture, empires, money and science.

title: Guns, Germs, and Steel
author: Jared Diamond
description: Why some societies conquered others: geography, crops, animals and germs shaped the fates of human societies.

title: The Discovery of India
author: Jawaharlal Nehru
description: Written in prison, a sweeping account of India's history, culture and philosophy from ancient times to the colonial era.

title: The Silk Roads
author: Peter Frankopan
description: A new history of the world told from the trade routes that connected East and West across Asia.

title: Meditations
author: Marcus Aurelius
description: Private notes of a Roman emperor on Stoic philosophy: duty, self-discipline, acceptance and calm in the face of hardship.

title: Man's Search for Meaning
author: Viktor E. Frankl
description: A psychiatrist's account of surviving Nazi concentration camps and his idea that finding meaning is the key to enduring suffering.

title: The Republic
author: Plato
description: Socrates and his companions debate justice, the ideal state, the philosopher king and the allegory of the cave.

title: Sophie's World
author: Jostein Gaarder
description: A teenage girl receives mysterious letters that take her through the history of Western philosophy, wrapped in a novel.
